source.date_preamble_meaning: Report selector metadata only; no performance columns were exported

baseline_join.method: Exact Campaign ID membership, then verify exact campaign-name agreement; no inferred ad IDs

projection_rules.cell_representation: Exact exported strings including empty strings, line breaks, narrow spaces and placeholder reasons
projection_rules.source_record_definition: One-based logical CSV data record after the header; not physical line number
projection_rules.rows_retained: All 17 Account rows plus all 114 exact-ID V2 rows

interpretation: All 17 exported account associations are paused. Their presence is not a claim of active V2 inheritance.
All 114 V2 component associations show Asset status Enabled and Status Not eligible. These are different status dimensions, not evidence that ads serve.
The V2 Status reason is exported literally as placeholder text; this file alone does not explain ineligibility.
Six ad-group sets of 15 headline and four description rows do not establish six RSA IDs or identify actual ads. Use the separate ad-table readback.
V2 has 96 distinct Item ID values across 114 rows. Reuse is not automatically a duplicate ad or duplicate conversion.
Repeated account sitelink copy has different Item IDs. No exact duplicate row exists in either retained subset; 289 repeated full rows belong to omitted scopes and were not silently deduplicated.
No dedicated Final URL column exists, but all 15 account sitelinks contain the legacy lplife URL within Asset text. Those strings do not verify redirect behavior or effective routing.
Blank Policy details do not prove policy approval. Policy status, ad IDs and final URLs require the separate detailed ad readback.
The paused hosted lead form exposes only its asset label here; privacy terms, fields, delivery and accepted-lead routing are not verified.
No call/phone/WhatsApp asset appears in these retained subsets. This does not establish staffed routing, website CTA behavior, manager-level controls or auto-created-asset settings.
Business ownership, claim accuracy, image rights, native destinations, consent, runtime measurement and separate release authorization remain acceptance gates.
